suggested_experiment_name: Borsanyi et al. 2016 lattice QCD axion mass (misalignment)
coupling_convention: theta_0 initial misalignment angle (dimensionless), as plotted on the y-axis vs m_A
notes: Lattice QCD calculation of topological susceptibility chi(T=0)=[75.6(1.8)(0.9) MeV]^4, used to predict the post-inflation dark-matter axion mass via m_A = sqrt(chi)/f_A. Paper reports strict lower bound m_A = 28(2) ueV (post-inflation, theta0=2.155), m_A=50(4) ueV for 50% misalignment contribution, and final estimate m_A = 50-1500 ueV. This is a theoretical prediction on the f_A-m_A plane (Figure 3), hence AxionMass. Data points are constructed from the quoted mass values using the standard relation m_A ~ 5.7 ueV x (1e12 GeV/f_A); f_A values are derived, not directly tabulated. No coupling-constant exclusion is presented. Not a haloscope, so no local DM density assumed.
